screens.title: Mask Collection
screens.description: A line-art mask rail gives each collectible a silhouette, name, and state without card shadows or thick comic outlines.

screens.title: Quest Journal
screens.description: A generous journal fragment uses a small route index and one clear quest entry with plenty of unboxed space.

screens.title: Desert Map
screens.description: Flat dune bands, a quiet route trace, and one waypoint put orientation ahead of decorative chrome.

limitations: The fine-line and flat-plane language is an author interpretation of the plan and the official desert, masks, and art-style descriptions; it is not asserted as canonical screen UI.
All masks, terrain marks, and vector art in this package are original studies; no official art files or font files are included.
The three specimens demonstrate component patterns only. Route data, quest logic, engine integration, and independent use testing remain for later work.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
